records.text: Curious (commenter handle; identity unverified) writes, I've been reflecting on Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s final days in the freedom shirt that he wore. Charlie (Charlie Kirk) believed freedom was worth dying for, and it really seems like he knew he was going to die.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
